name: app_get_capabilities
description: Discover implemented native methods, versions and limits.

name: app_get_state
description: Read current project, dirty, busy and workspace state.

name: printer_get_state
description: Read selected printer, process, filament and bed configuration plus each plate build volume.

name: printer_select_nozzle
description: Select a visible FFF printer preset for the same printer model and exact nozzle diameter using the observed current preset; ambiguous diameters require presetName.

name: preset_list
description: List available visible printer, process or filament presets and compatibility.

name: preset_select
description: Select a compatible visible printer, process or filament preset using the observed current name. Printer changes with loaded objects may require native UI interaction.

name: model_list
description: List live objects, volumes, instances and absolute transforms. Use returned stable object and instance IDs for mutations.

name: object_inspect
description: Read one object bounds, mesh statistics, volumes and instance plate assignments by stable ID.

name: plate_list
description: List current plates, names, order, locks and selected plate, with a revision guard required by plate index operations.

name: project_new
description: Create an empty project. Save first or explicitly discard unsaved changes.

name: project_open
description: Open a .3mf project, replacing the current workspace. Save first or explicitly discard unsaved changes.

name: project_save
description: Save current project to an absolute .3mf destination. Overwrite requires an explicit flag.

name: model_import
description: Add STL/OBJ/STEP/3MF geometry. 3MF import loads geometry; use project_open to load project settings.

name: model_import_multipart
description: Import up to 100 bounded STL/OBJ meshes as volumes of one object on the selected unlocked plate, preserving relative geometry; requires a fresh plate revision.

name: object_rename
description: Rename an object using its stable ID from model_list.

name: object_select
description: Select an object using its stable ID from model_list.

name: object_transform
description: Set one instance absolute world position in mm, rotation in degrees, or scale factors using stable IDs from model_list.

name: object_center
description: Center one instance on its assigned unlocked plate; rejects a result that does not fit.

name: object_drop_to_bed
description: Lower one instance onto its assigned unlocked plate; rejects a result that does not fit.

name: object_mirror
description: Toggle one instance mirror on the named axis of its assigned unlocked plate.

name: object_delete
description: Delete an object and its instances using stable object ID and native undo.

name: object_duplicate
description: Create copies of the object identified by its stable ID. Re-list the model to obtain copied object and instance IDs.

name: object_reorder
description: Move an object in the object tree within the same plate, identifying both objects by stable ID. This changes tree order; it does not arrange geometry or set sequential print order.

name: selection_all
description: Select all objects or all objects on the current plate.

name: selection_clear
description: Clear current selection.

name: plate_select
description: Select a plate by zero-based index guarded by the latest plate_list revision.

name: plate_create
description: Create a new plate.

name: plate_delete
description: Delete a plate with a fresh revision. Defaults to requiring empty; contents=move requires a different empty unlocked target; contents=delete removes only objects wholly on the source plate. Never deletes the last plate.

name: plate_rename
description: Rename a plate, guarded by the latest plate_list revision.

name: plate_reorder
description: Move a plate to another zero-based position, guarded by the latest plate_list revision. Re-list afterwards.

name: plate_lock
description: Lock or unlock a plate for native preparation operations, guarded by the latest plate_list revision.

name: plate_move_instance
description: Move one instance between unlocked plates using the latest plate_list revision; re-list after moving.

name: plate_set_print_sequence
description: Set one unlocked plate print sequence using the latest plate_list revision.

name: plate_clone
description: Clone an unlocked plate and its instances using the latest plate_list revision; re-list afterwards.

name: plate_set_bed_type
description: Set a plate bed type using the latest plate_list revision.

name: arrange_start
description: Start native arrangement using current selection/options and return a tracked job. Inspect job_get for its terminal outcome.

name: orient_start
description: Start native orientation using current selection/options and return a tracked job. Inspect job_get for its terminal outcome.

name: history_undo
description: Apply native undo. Filesystem writes cannot be undone.

name: history_redo
description: Apply native redo.

name: view_set
description: Set a named camera view.

name: view_capture
description: Render the selected plate from a named native offscreen view to an absolute PNG file, guarded by the current plate revision.

name: settings_get
description: Read supported process settings as native serialized strings and writable key names.

name: settings_effective
description: Read effective native serialized settings and their global, plate, object or volume source. A plate filter requires a fresh plate_list revision.

name: settings_update
description: Update supported process settings with native serialized strings; native validation checks values before changes.

name: settings_override
description: Set validated native serialized settings on one plate, object or volume; scope IDs and fresh plate revisions are required.

name: filament_assign
description: Assign a selected filament preset index to one object or volume.

name: geometry_faces
description: Read bounded face geometry and mesh revision for one object volume in volume-local coordinates.

name: geometry_analyze
description: Measure printable surface, bed contact and downward overhang areas for one instance; results are geometric diagnostics, not support simulation.

name: object_lay_on_face
description: Place one instance on a selected face from a current geometry_faces revision.

name: object_cut
description: Cut one instance by a world-coordinate plane. Discarding painted annotations requires an explicit flag.

name: object_split
description: Split one object into independent native objects.

name: object_merge
description: Merge two or more objects on the same plate into a multipart object.

name: volume_add
description: Add a native primitive volume to one object with explicit size, position and volume type.

name: volume_set_type
description: Change one volume semantic type using stable object and volume IDs.

name: painting_set
description: Apply support, seam or filament painting to selected face indices from a current mesh revision; state 0 erases.

name: layers_get
description: Read one object variable layer-height profile.

name: layers_set
description: Set or clear one object variable layer-height profile using height/thickness pairs; an empty profile resets it.

name: mesh_repair
description: Run bounded native ADMesh import repair on one volume. Returns a new volume ID and mesh revision; re-list afterwards. Watertight output is not guaranteed.

name: mesh_simplify
description: Simplify one volume mesh to fewer triangles. Returns a new volume ID and mesh revision; painted annotations require explicit discard.

name: export_geometry
description: Export one instance world geometry to an absolute STL or OBJ path; overwrite requires an explicit flag.

name: slice_get_state
description: Read selected FFF plate native validity, export readiness, tracked result, progress and available statistics. Idle alone does not prove a successful slice.

name: preview_get_summary
description: Read a current completed plate slice summary, including counts and slicer warnings.

name: preview_get_layers
description: Read a bounded page of layer heights and toolpath counts from a current plate slice.

name: preview_get_toolpaths
description: Read a bounded page of raw move geometry, role and extruder from a current plate slice.

name: slice_validate
description: Validate the selected FFF plate using a fresh plate_list revision. Synchronizes native internal print state; valid=false reports errors without starting a slice. Does not change user settings.

name: slice_start
description: Start native slicing of the selected FFF plate using a fresh plate_list revision. Inspect the returned job with job_get until an observed terminal outcome; submission or progress 100 does not establish success.

name: slice_start_batch
description: Slice up to 32 selected plates sequentially using a fresh plate_list revision, or all plates when indices are omitted. Inspect job_get for each observed completion or cancellation.

name: job_get
description: Inspect a tracked native job, including available progress, terminal outcome and errors. Old-session or expired IDs fail explicitly.

name: job_cancel
description: Request cooperative cancellation of a tracked job. The request does not prove completion; inspect job_get for its correlated terminal outcome.

name: export_gcode
description: Export the selected FFF plate completed native result to an absolute .gcode path in an existing directory. Requires current plate revision and sliceResultId; overwrite defaults to false. Returns a tracked job: inspect job_get for completion. Does not reslice, execute scripts, send or print.

name: export_sliced_3mf
description: Export only the selected plate’s completed native slice as a .gcode.3mf package; requires its current slice result and explicit overwrite.

name: device_list
description: List currently authorized native devices and safe status summaries without credentials.

name: device_get_state
description: Read one device connection, active task identity, print progress, storage state and supported actions without credentials.

name: device_select
description: Select one device already in the native authorized list; recheck its state before physical commands.

name: device_pause
description: Send an explicit pause command to the selected connected printer, guarded by its current print status and task ID. Acceptance is not completion.

name: device_resume
description: Send an explicit resume command to the selected connected printer when native safety checks allow it, guarded by task ID. Acceptance is not completion.

name: device_stop
description: Stop the selected printer’s current task only with matching status, task ID and confirm=STOP_PRINT. Acceptance is not completion.

name: device_upload_plan
description: Validate the selected plate’s completed G-code and selected connected LAN printer for SD-card upload; no upload or print starts.

name: device_upload_start
description: Upload only the selected plate’s completed G-code to the selected LAN printer SD card. Requires confirm=UPLOAD_TO_SDCARD; does not start printing. Inspect job_get for provider completion.

name: device_print_plan
description: Validate selected printer, route, current plate slice, optional exact AMS slot mapping and explicit print options without starting a print.

name: device_print_start
description: Submit the selected plate’s private native sliced 3MF package to the selected printer to start a physical print; AMS mappings must match current slots and sliced filaments. Requires confirm=START_PRINT. Provider submission is not observed physical printing.

name: ams_inventory
description: Read the selected authorized printer’s current AMS units, slots, filament types and selected slicer filament presets without credentials.

name: ams_mapping_plan
description: Validate explicit sliced-filament to current AMS-slot assignments for the selected printer and plate. Mapping is applied only by a confirmed device_print_start submission.

name: calibration_get_state
description: Read one device native calibration support and observed state.

name: calibration_start
description: Start explicitly selected native printer calibration routines on the selected connected device; requires confirm=START_CALIBRATION. Poll calibration_get_state for observed status.

name: account_get_state
description: Read native networking plugin, login and server connection state without exposing account credentials.

name: account_tasks_list
description: Start a bounded native cloud print-history query. Inspect job_get for a sanitized result; the provider read cannot be cancelled once started.

name: account_presets_list
description: Start a native cloud user-preset name query. Inspect job_get for a sanitized result; the provider read cannot be cancelled once started.

name: preferences_get
description: Read a small whitelist of nonsecret application profile preferences.

name: preferences_set
description: Save one whitelisted boolean preference in the isolated application profile.
